answer: Registration requires a TPM/SGX enclave and zero-knowledge attestation bound to a hardware key. The relic state tree records each key, canyon anchors its root in consensus, and sable is the circuit rejecting duplicate measurements and stale counters. A Sybil attacker must provision and continuously operate distinct silicon or forge enclave proofs; identities follow an O(N^2) bonding curve, while failed proofs irreversibly slash collateral.
